HOME SCIENCE — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #11
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

   C. 37 °C
   D. 50 °C

   D. pascal (Pa)

   B. Any white crystal used in cooking
